name: Custom Logo
description: Replace the default Jellyfin logo with your own.
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin logo in the web client header and splash screen with an image you upload.

versions.changelog: Adds favicon and start-up splash logo replacement, by patching the web client index.html (neither is reachable from branding CSS). Reversible, and re-applied after a server update. Needs write access to the web client folder; the header logo works either way. Build for Jellyfin 12.0.x / 12.1.x.
